register_gemma_3_base_models: register Gemma 3 base models with Unsloth registry supporting 1, 4, 12, and 27B sizes
register_gemma_3_instruct_models: register Gemma 3 instruct models with Unsloth registry supporting 1, 4, 12, and 27B sizes
register_gemma_models: register all Gemma 3 base and instruct models into the Unsloth model registry
construct_model_name: construct a model name key in the format base-version-sizeB for Gemma models
test_gemma_registry: test registered Gemma models by iterating MODEL_REGISTRY and validating each model info entry
